facts.fact: NIDA says it shares its national register with about 96 public and private institutions so they can verify the identity of their customers.
NIDA says about 96 public and private institutions, three of them in Zanzibar, use its register to verify people, for SIM, bank account, company and passport services.

systems.system: Central electronic register of registration and identification of persons

TZA.note: No link between civil register and ID stated.
NIDA's data centre and recovery centre hold its own data; no renting to others stated.
Only an adults-only share (79% of those 18 and over); no share of the whole population.
NIDA registers people aged 18 and over; no number at birth.

facts.fact: NIDA, the national authority, keeps the central register and runs registration of people through 153 district offices linked to its data centre.
NIDA says its in-house experts built 24 of 42 planned systems and provide technical support, ending dependence on foreign contractors.
NIDA says that by building its systems in-house it owns the actual program copies of the national ID system and is free of foreign contractors' licence limits.
NIDA says its register is used for company registration and for issuing taxpayer numbers (TIN), among other services.
NIDA says it had registered 24,495,804 people by February 2024 and produced 20,832,225 National Identification Numbers and 20,286,420 ID cards.

TZA.note: NIDA's data centre is not stated to be for hire.

facts.fact: NIDA says its national register enabled the issuing of taxpayer numbers (TIN).
